questions.question: At St George's Park, who holds the record for 'Most Wickets' (T20)?
Guess the player: 2720 runs in 114 innings (average 32.77, high score 203*, 3 centuries) for Dolphins. (combined T20 + List A career totals.)
At which ground did Beverley Clulee record their career-best innings (61*, T20)?
questions.explanation: It was at Polokwane Oval, against Limpopo Lillies on 2013/10/12.

questions.question: What was the name of the women's rebel team that toured South Africa during the 1970s and 1980s?
questions.explanation: The Unicorns toured SA from 1972 to 1985/86.

questions.question: In head-to-head List A meetings, who has the edge, Lions or Cobras?

questions.explanation: It was at Potchefstroom Oval — highest total of 420, against Boland on 2019/02/02.
